chunks: From Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) who said: Indeed, Allah the Exalted did not grant Satan authority over those who have faith.
But over those who take him as their guardian and disobey His command.

key_terms.يَتَوَلَّوْنَهُمْ: Those who take him as guardian/leader

ai.seo_question: Who does Satan have authority over according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: In *Kamal al-Din*, Shaykh al-Saduq records Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifying that Satan's authority (*sultan*) is not absolute over all believers but is conditional upon their voluntary submission to his whispers. This distinction underscores the Shia theological principle that true faith involves active resistance to Satan, limiting his influence to those who heed his guidance and thereby disobey God's command.
